sources.snippet: Model Introduction Apex-35B-V1.0 is the first model from Apex Intelligence, developed for both general-purpose use and research and supported by the Claude Code (v2.1.280 preferred) harness. It combines coding, tool use, question answering, and deep search with research tasks in AI, computational science, and robotics simulation.
